questions.q: In the summary, what does Seligman call optimism and pessimism?
a: Two explanatory styles for how we account for bad events
Two personality types that are fixed early in childhood
Two coping mechanisms for handling sudden stress
Two thinking styles that depend on intelligence
questions.why: The overview says both are explanatory styles, meaning the way we explain bad events in our lives.

questions.q: How do optimists explain setbacks differently from pessimists?
a: As temporary, specific to the situation and externally caused
As permanent, general to their whole life and self-caused
As random, unavoidable and unrelated to anything they did
As inherited, stable traits that no effort can change
questions.why: The overview lists the three differences: optimists see problems as temporary, specific and external, while pessimists do the reverse.

questions.q: What three things does the ABC technique ask you to record?
a: The adversity, your belief about it and the consequence
The answer, the behavior and the correction
The awareness, the breathing and the calm
The assumption, the barrier and the commitment
questions.why: The summary explains ABC as noting the Adversity, the Belief you form about it and the Consequence of that belief.

questions.q: What did Seligman find when he split university freshmen into optimists and pessimists?
a: Optimists exceeded expectations while pessimists fell behind
Pessimists earned better grades despite lower test scores
The two groups performed the same but optimists were happier
Optimism mattered only for students who played sports
questions.why: At the University of Pennsylvania, the optimists did better than predicted and the pessimists did worse.

questions.q: According to the summary, how does optimism affect physical health?
a: It strengthens the immune system and helped cancer patients
It replaces the need for exercise and a balanced diet
It prevents every stress-related illness in later life
It raises energy levels but weakens the body's defenses
questions.why: The summary says studies found optimism boosts the immune system and even improved the health of cancer patients.
